chapterTitle: Chapter 18 Ethers and Epoxides; Thiols and Sulfides
title: Problem 18-4

pages.text: PROBLEM 18-4 Review the mechanism of oxymercuration shown in Figure 8.4, and then write the mechanism of the alkoxymercuration reaction of 1-methylcyclopentene with ethanol. Use curved arrows to show the electron flow in each step.
